items.html: Second, her being a complete Partzuf of ten Sefirot, except that the measure of her stature is in the back of ZA, from the chest and below. But her lights, which are in the five Sefirot of ZA — KHB and HG — have not illuminated in his four lower [Sefirot], and therefore they were not drawn into her and did not illuminate in her. And understand this with the above.
